situation (example wording): "give me the share of all rape clearances that were prosecution declined in 2025", "what share of murders were cleared by exception in 2025", "what was the share of all rapes that were cleared by exception in the US in 2025", "give me the share of all rape clearances that were prosecution declined in 2025 by state"
what the app does today: Declined ("This isn't available: a state or national sum of several crimes, a breakdown, a change or a ranking").
proposed behavior: For a state or the nation, one year: the share of a crime's clearances (arrest plus the five exceptional types) or of its offenses (not cleared included) that were of one clearance type (cleared by arrest, cleared by exceptional means, or one exceptional type), from the clearance-by-type sums over the agencies that reported (P171). One figure is a sentence ("In the United States in 2025, 9.1% of the rape clearances were prosecution declined, summed over the 12,345 agencies that reported.") with the agencies line; "by state" is a table with a row for each state, in alphabetical order: the share, the clearances (or offenses) it divides, and the agencies reporting. Several years stay declined (ask one year); a state with nothing to divide is a blank row.
exact default or choices offered: The sentence, or the table by state, the agencies line, then the Source line.
why: Jeff 2026-11-21 (through the coordinator): the national and state clearance share by type is built on the clearance-by-type sums.
